notes.title: Ghosting Vandal Full Update
notes.content: [p]Ghosting Vandal's base game experience is now available![/p][p][/p][p]Includes 8 levels leading to the conclusion of the main campaign.[/p][p](Notes on the future are at the end of this article)[/p][p][/p][p]-Final 2 levels have been added.[/p][p]-A new "gunmode" has been added.[/p][p]-Gameplay rebalance.[/p][p]-Improved mouse/keyboard combo controls.[/p][p](a gamepad is still recommended)[/p][p]-Minor bug and graphical fixes.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for supporting the development of this game![/p][p]Unfortunately I am solo developing this with no support other than you (which means a lot!), so it's been hard finding free time while keeping a full time job and a certain level of social life; I would love to expand on this and add more levels in the future.[/p][p]What I have planned for future updates:[/p][p]-Button mapping[/p][p]-Multi-Language support[/p][p]-More story content, tying some loose ends.[/p][p][/p][p]Hope to see you again in the future, HAVE FUN![/p]

notes.title: A VERY IMPORTANT UPDATE, if I may say so myself.
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43525788/cedb27794ebf8d506c91827a7ba406376213d76e.jpg[/img]

HERE'S WHAT'S NEW IN THE VERY IMPORTANT UPDATE:

-Gameplay physics adjusted to give you better control over the character
-Added a dodge ability, press the assigned button to perform a dodge
-Changed the layout and visuals of some levels
-Other adjustments and behaviour
-Small dialogue changes
-A couple musical changes
-Performance improvements

A BIG APOLOGY FOR THIS, SOMETHING SILLY ABOUT SAVES:

-Had to reset the saving system, I apologize if your save is lost, if you want to restore it, try going to the %appdata% folder in your system and looking for your previous save. I'd say it's worth revisiting all levels, so maybe you don't need to restore your data, but that is up to you, I'm sorry if this is an inconvenience, I'm working to improve and streamline the overall development and I'm only one developer, not an excuse, just saying I get a little tired and screw up a bit sometimes.

ALSO A BIG THANKS FOR SUPPORTING THE GAME!

I am working on more improvements and the final levels of the game, please stay tuned!

notes.title: WHAT'S IN THE HEAVEN'S DOOR UPDATE?
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43525788/550c7f8af902f6f59e596ff006aefd55a7b05d3f.png[/img]

WHAT'S NEW IN THE LATEST GHOSTING VANDAL UPDATE?

GAMEPLAY:
-Aerial control rebalance, recover easier from bouncing
-Bounceback rebalance on melee, your blades don't send you backwards as much
-General physics and control rebalance
-Boss difficulty adjustments

New Gunmode: Raging Saw
A slow moving disc that hurts enemies on its path, stick it to walls or to the ground to deal continuous damage. These slow moving attacks also serve as improvised platforms for you to bounce on!
Talk to the lizzard at the Guild HUB to obtain your new ability.

Mission: "The Other Side"
Take on a new mission in Ravenett Forest, face new foes in a dark otherwordly place culminating on a challenging boss fight that hints at the finale of the Ghosting Vandal adventure.
(But we're not done yet!! More missions will be added later)

New HUB Area
Land in the Neon Arlenis Guild Cafeteria, get battle tips and general bits of information on the world.

Stay tuned for more, the next update is already in the works!

notes.title: Heaven's Door update changes!
notes.content:
Updated:

*Added new mission: The Other Side
-Take on the mysterious Ravenett Forest, face the looming threat of the Ghosting Hunters

*New Gunmode: Raging Saw
-Unlock the Raging Saw disc ability, a slow moving blade causing harm across its path onto your enemies
-Bounce on your own saw disc if the action requires it, or use it as a platform

*New HUB Area
-Land in the Neon Arlenis Guild cafeteria, get battle tips and bits of information

*General Gameplay Adjustments
-Revised Ghost Wheel physics for better aerial control
-Reduced bounceback on both Blade Melee and Ghost Wheel
-Boss fights various adjustments (Armadas are considerably less cruel)
-Miniboss readjustments
-Other minor graphical adjustments and enemy behaviour.
